saw_lines: People financing a treatment compare the monthly payment against the price, and they decide before they ever read the fine print.
So the monthly figure has to lead, or shoppers leave before they ever ask whether they can afford it.
Your homepage leads with Flexible Financing for Aesthetic Treatments, and the first move is to put a monthly figure beside each treatment on the page.
ads_1: Paid tests built on payment plan questions, led by the treatment price
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Twitter and Youtube
